design_evaluation.summary: A polished dark/light personal tech hub with a strong hero, clear primary navigation, distinct card grid, working theme toggle, mobile menu, login modal, and a consent-gated AI chat. Hierarchy and interaction affordances are excellent; minor issues include overlapping floating widgets obscuring content on mobile and in card row, low-contrast stat labels, and no visible focus/a11y affordances in the screenshots.
strengths: Strong visual hierarchy: large two-tone hero headline ('AI Testing & Integration. Building Trust.') clearly dominates, with supporting subtitle, stats strip, and CTA buttons in descending weight (ui-home-desktop).
Clear primary navigation with well-differentiated items; 'Break it' is visually emphasized as a highlighted/red action (ui-primary-navigation).
Theme toggle works: light mode preserves layout structure and content parity with dark mode, showing a robust theming implementation (ui-theme-toggle).
Mobile menu is clean and readable with large tap targets and a close affordance; nav items mirror desktop (ui-mobile-menu).
Login modal has proper scoping (blurred backdrop), Login/Register tabs, labeled Email/Password fields, clear primary CTA and 'Forgot password?' recovery link (ui-login-modal).
Chat panel leads with a responsible-AI consent gate: disclaimer, required 'I agree' checkbox, disabled 'Agree & Start Chat' until consent, and link to terms (ui-chat-opens).
Consistent card grid with icon, title, description, and color-coded action links (Explore/Scan/Verify/Check) gives predictable interaction patterns.
issues: Floating 'Voice Agent' pill and AI chat bubble overlap the 'Reliability & Fact Check' card, hiding part of its description text ('unsupported AI cla...') (ui-home-desktop).
In mobile view, the Voice Agent widget and chat bubble cover card content ('Adversarial Simulation' title/description partially obscured) (ui-mobile-menu).
Low-contrast secondary labels ('ARTICLES TODAY', 'RSS SOURCES', 'AUTO-UPDATED') are hard to read on the dark stat strip (ui-home-desktop).
Terminal code panel text is clipped ('--workers=4...' and 'chat-widget.spec.ts 2.16') in some states (ui-primary-navigation vs ui-theme-toggle inconsistency).

No visible keyboard focus indicators, skip links, or ARIA cues can be confirmed from the screenshots; 'AI Integration & Quality Management' badge contrast is borderline in light theme (ui-theme-toggle).
Live Feed button color shifts between screenshots (cyan in dark, magenta in light); verify intentional theme mapping for brand consistency.

candidate_findings.title: article-proxy-ssrf-loopback-rejection
candidate_findings.expected: Response must not proxy the internal URL; it should be a controlled 4xx JSON error (e.g., 400/403/422) mentioning an invalid or blocked URL, with no internal response content, title, or stack trace leaked.
candidate_findings.actual: The SSRF guard is functionally effective but violates the documented status contract. The response did not proxy the loopback URL: title and image are null, no internal /api/health content leaked, no stack trace or sensitive markers appeared, and the JSON error message explicitly states the fetch was refused because the target resolved to a private/internal IP (127.0.0.1). Security semantics are satisfied (no 200 fetch of internal content, no 500 leak). However, the response status was 200 instead of the expected controlled 4xx (400/403/422), so expected_status_match is false. The guard communicates rejection via an in-band 'error' field with HTTP 200, which is a status-code contract deviation, not a security failure.
reproduction_steps: Compare the sanitized response with the declared semantic contract.
